  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $ and a polynomial $ f \in R[X] $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ applied to $ f $ is given by $ D^{(k)}(f) = \sum_{i} \binom{i}{k} \cdot a_i \cdot X^{i - k} $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ f $. This expression sums over all monomials in $ f $, scaling each by the binomial coefficient $ \binom{i}{k} $ and reducing the exponent by $ k $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Upper Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound on Weighted Order of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For any extended natural number $n$, if every monomial $d$ with $\text{weight}(w, d) < n$ has zero coefficient in the multivariate power series $f$, then $n \leq \text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$, where $\text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$ denotes the weighted order of $f$ with respect to the weight function $w$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Lower Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if every monomial $ d $ with weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) < n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to $ w $ satisfies $ n \leq \text{weightedOrder}_w(f) $.

items.informal_name: Coefficients of Multivariate Power Series with Weight Below Weighted Order Are Zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ of a monomial $ d $ is strictly less than the weighted order of $ f $, then the coefficient of $ d $ in $ f $ is zero. The weighted order of $ f $ is defined as the minimal natural number $ n $ such that there exists a monomial with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ whose weighted sum equals $ n $. If $ f $ is the zero series, its weighted order is $ \top $ (infinity).

items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, if $ f $ is a monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, a) $ where $ a \neq 0 $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to a weight function $ w: \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ is equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $. In symbols, $ \text{weightedOrder}_w(\text{monomial}(d, a)) = \text{weight}_w(d) $.

items.informal_name: Lower bound on degree of support under exponentiation in additive monoid algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \deg : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \deg(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \in A $, and for any $ f \in R[A] $ and $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \cdot \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} \deg(a) \leq \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f^n)} \deg(a) $ holds, where $ \text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Support of Derivative Implies Original Exponent $n + 1$
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ}, n ∈ (Polynomial.derivative p).support → n + 1 ∈ p.support
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$, if a natural number $n$ is in the support of the derivative of $p$, then $n + 1$ is in the support of $p$.

items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Support of Derivative Finite Support Function is Contained in Range n for Degree Less Than n
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ},
  p.natDegree < n → (Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp p).support ⊆ Finset.range n
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ with natural degree less than $ n $, the support of the derivative finite support function of $ p $ is a subset of the finite set $ \{0, 1, \dots, n-1\} $.

items.informal_name: Subadditivity of Support Infimum under Multiplication in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : Add A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
    ∀ (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt + g.support.inf degt ≤ (f * g).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For any subadditive degree function $\deg : A \to T$ on an additive monoid $A$, and for all elements $f, g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of the supports of $f$ and $g$ under $\deg$ is less than or equal to the infimum of the support of their product $f \cdot g$ under $\deg$. Formally, $\inf_{\text{supp}(f)} \deg + \inf_{\text{supp}(g)} \deg \leq \inf_{\text{supp}(f \cdot g)} \deg$.
